blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Aberdeen. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Aberdeen, Abbotsford: 25 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 5 of 9 Abbotsford communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Aberdeen fell from 29 in June to 25 in September, and 13 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 5.7% of Abbotsford’s 440 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Aberdeen?
Aberdeen also had 7 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in September, against 25 houses listed. The Aberdeen condos and townhomes page has those figures.

items.t: Aberdeen condos and townhomes for sale

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Aberdeen?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 25 houses listed in Aberdeen. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Aberdeen a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Aberdeen had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Aberdeen from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 13 houses sold in Aberdeen over those 4 months, out of 215 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Aberdeen?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
